title: CoXQL: A Dataset for Parsing Explanation Requests in Conversational XAI Systems
reasoning: The paper is focused on natural language processing tasks related to intent recognition and parsing for Explainable AI (XAI). It introduces a technical benchmark (CoXQL) and evaluates the performance of various LLMs on it. There is no evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics; the term 'faithful' used in the text refers to the technical accuracy and reliability of AI-generated explanations.
